description: A spare, gallery-quiet living room with a raw whitewashed concrete block wall that fills the entire back plane, its rough-cut rectangular stones adding deep, tactile texture. The floor is covered with a large flat-weave jute rug in natural straw tones. A low, generously curved sectional sofa in soft grey-oat bouclé spans the center in an organic crescent shape, dressed with two simple square linen throw pillows in cream. A solid walnut block coffee table — substantial and rectilinear with thick, minimal legs — sits before the sofa, holding a small arrangement of dried green foliage in a matte ceramic vessel, a pair of stacked coffee-table books, and a small sculptural stone object. A portion of an additional upholstered armchair in the same oat tone is visible at the far right edge. The ceiling zone holds a warm, diffused luminous glow that radiates softly downward across the sofa and coffee table, creating a halo of warmth against the grey stone wall. The atmosphere is rigorously minimal, almost monastic, with every element in the same tonal family of ivory, grey, sand, and walnut. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered and level with a wide establishing view showing the full sofa, coffee table, and expansive stone wall backdrop.
